name: NeRV (Neural Reflectance and Visibility Fields)
definition: A method that takes as input a set of images of a scene illuminated by unconstrained known lighting, and produces as output a 3D representation that can be rendered from novel viewpoints under arbitrary lighting conditions, including indirect illumination effects.
summary: NeRV is a differentiable inverse rendering method that reconstructs 3D scenes from images using neural approximations for visibility and surface intersections to efficiently handle indirect illumination.
